name: exhaustive_az
description: 16M-step PPO league over the full roster (24 envs, 20% latest-self mirror), gated by a PPO-vs-scripted:hard baseline (10 matches per matchup, full NxN). Then the AZ arc: 32 doomsday-mirror scripted:hard expert matches written as behavior-cloning shards, followed by two UNGATED exhaustive-matrix AZ cycles — each cycle's self-play is the exact 155-bo3-match matrix (one net-vs-scripted match per ordered deck pair + one pure self-play match per unordered pair) on 28 workers with the hybrid backend (C++ actor for the self-play cells, Python for the vs-scripted cells), trained with the auto 2x shard window (each pass covers this cycle + the previous one, so cycle 1's window picks up the expert shards). Gating is off (gate_every 0): the final candidate is promoted to gen__azfinal unconditionally at run completion. Finishes with the promoted AZ net in MCTS search mode (az:gen) vs scripted:hard over the same full NxN baseline, 10 matches per matchup.
